## Compare 16s/ITS versus ME-NMR 

```{r, eval=FALSE}
phyXlong <- phyX %>% 
  subset_samples(!is.na(Sample.ID)) %>% 
  transform_sample_counts(function(x) x / sum(x)) %>% 
  filter_taxa(function(x) sum(x > 0)>10, TRUE) %>% 
  psmelt() %>%  
  dplyr::select(OTU:TSP, ta1:ta7) %>% 
  full_join(MEconc_newlong %>% 
              filter(!is.na(Participant)) %>% 
              filter(`Blood origen`=='ME') , 
            by = c('Sample.ID' = 'Sample ID', 'Participant', 'Period')) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Abundance)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(logy)) %>% 
  filter(!str_detect(met,'EREC')) %>% 
  filter(!str_detect(met,'TSP')) %>% 
  dplyr::select(OTU:ta7,met,category, type:logy)


tb_cor <- phyXlong %>% 
  group_by(OTU,met,ta1,ta2,ta3,ta4,ta5,ta6,ta7) %>% 
  do(cor.test(data = ., ~ logy + Abundance,method = 'spearman') %>% tidy)

tb_lmer <- phyXlong %>% 
  # filter(met=='uridine') %>% 
  # filter(OTU=='sp1') %>% 
  mutate(logabu = log(Abundance+0.0001)) %>% 
  group_by(OTU,met,ta1,ta2,ta3,ta4,ta5,ta6,ta7) %>% 
  do(lmer(data = ., logy ~  logabu + factor(day) + (1|Participant) + (logabu|Participant)) %>% tidy)

# tb_lmer %>% filter(str_detect(term,'log')) %>% arrange(p.value)


save(file = 'microbiome_vs_nmr_models.RData', list = c('tb_lmer', 'tb_cor','phyXlong'))
```


### All versus all (16s vs NMR)

```{r}
load(file = 'microbiome_vs_nmr_models.RData')

fmrt <- list(
  
  p.value = colDef(
    cell = function(value) {
      if (is.na(value)) return("")
      formatC(value, format = "e", digits = 2)
    }
  ),
  
  estimate = colDef(
    cell = function(value) {
      if (is.na(value)) return("")
      formatC(value, format = "e", digits = 2)
    }
  ),
  
  std.error = colDef(
    cell = function(value) {
      if (is.na(value)) return("")
      formatC(value, format = "e", digits = 2)
    }
  )
)

tb_lmer2 <- tb_lmer %>% 
  filter(term=='logabu') %>% 
  ungroup %>% 
  mutate(ta5 = ifelse(ta5 %in% c('F__','__'),'Other',ta5),
         ta5lmp = ta5 %>% fct_lump(n = 14),
         qval = p.adjust(p.value,'fdr'),
         pvcut = ifelse(p.value<0.05,'sign','ns'))

tb_lmer2 %>% 
  ggplot(data =.,aes(estimate,-log10(p.value))) + 
  geom_point()

tb_lmer2 %>% 
  ungroup %>% 
  dplyr::select(met,ta4,ta5,ta6,ta7,estimate,std.error, p.value) %>% 
  reactable(columns = fmrt)

tb_lmer2 %>% filter(str_detect(term,'log')) %>% 
  ggplot(data =.,aes(ta5lmp, estimate,fill = pvcut)) + 
  geom_boxplot() + 
  theme(legend.position = 'bottom') + 
  coord_flip()

# tb_lmer %>% filter(str_detect(term,'log')) %>% 
# group_by(ta5lmp) %>% 
# dplyr::summarise(nneg = sum(estimate<0), npos = sum(estimate>0), 
# pv = 1 - pbinom(max(npos,nneg)-1,nneg+npos,0.5))

gHM <- tb_lmer2 %>% 
  group_by(OTU) %>% 
  mutate(mq1 = min(qval)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(met) %>% 
  mutate(mq2 = min(qval)) %>% 
  filter(mq1<0.05 & mq2<0.05) %>% 
  mutate(OTU2 = paste(ta4,ta5,ta6,ta7,OTU, sep = '') %>% factor()) %>% 
  ggplot(data = ., aes(as.numeric(OTU2),substr(met,1,20),fill = estimate)) + 
  geom_tile() + 
  scale_fill_gradient2(mid = 'white', midpoint = 0)
ggsave(filename = 'Met_16s.pdf', plot = gHM, height = 20, width = 20)

phyXlong %>% 
  # filter(met=='lactate') %>% filter(OTU=='sp145') %>% 
  filter(met=='butyrate') %>% filter(OTU=='sp189') %>% 
  mutate(logabu = log(Abundance+0.0001)) %>% 
  ggplot(data = ., aes(logabu,logy, color = Participant, group = Participant)) + 
  geom_point() + geom_line() + stat_smooth(method = lm, se = F) + facet_wrap(~ta6 + ta7)
```

### Multivariate prediciton models using nested-cv

```{r}
library(caret)
library(nestedcv)

make_loio_folds <- function(ids) {
  if (anyNA(ids)) {
    stop("ids must not contain missing values")
  }
  
  ids <- as.character(ids)
  n_ids <- length(unique(ids))
  
  if (n_ids < 3L) {
    stop("At least three unique IDs are required for nested leave-one-ID-out CV")
  }
  
  # Outer test folds: indices refer to rows in the complete dataset
  outer_folds <- split(
    seq_along(ids),
    factor(ids, levels = unique(ids))
  )
  
  # Inner test folds: indices refer to rows in each outer-training dataset
  inner_folds <- lapply(outer_folds, function(outer_test) {
    outer_train <- setdiff(seq_along(ids), outer_test)
    train_ids   <- ids[outer_train]
    
    split(
      seq_along(train_ids),
      factor(train_ids, levels = unique(train_ids))
    )
  })
  
  list(
    outer_folds = unname(outer_folds),
    inner_folds = lapply(inner_folds, unname)
  )
}


```

#### From 16s to NMR

```{r, eval=FALSE}
phyXpp <- phyX %>% 
  subset_samples(!is.na(Sample.ID)) %>% 
  subset_samples(!is.na(X2.hydroxyisovaleric.acid)) %>% 
  transform_sample_counts(function(x) x / sum(x)) %>% 
  filter_taxa(function(x) sum(x > 0)>10, TRUE) 

X <- phyXpp@otu_table %>% data.frame()
X <- log(X + +0.0001)
Y <- phyXpp@sam_data %>% data.frame() %>% dplyr::select(-TSP,-ERECTIC)

folds <- make_loio_folds(Y$Participant)

unmet <- unique(MEconc_newlong$met) 
unmet <- unmet[!(unmet %in% c("ERECTIC","TSP"))]

for (i in unmet){
  print(i)
  yy <- MEconc_newlong %>% filter(met==i) %>% filter(!is.na(Participant)) %>% filter(`Blood origen`=='ME')
  
  YY <- Y %>% 
    left_join(yy, by = c('Participant','Period','Cycle.day' = 'Cycle day'))
  
  y <- YY$logy
  sdy <- sd(y)
  
  fit <- nestedcv::nestcv.train(
    x = X,
    y = y,
    method = "spls",                  # any caret model
    preProc = c("center", 'scale'),
    tuneGrid = expand.grid(K = 1:3,# K sets number of components
                           eta = seq(0,1,0.1), # eta sets sparsity
                           kappa = 0.5),
    outer_folds = folds$outer_folds,
    inner_folds = folds$inner_folds,
    finalCV = FALSE,
    cv.cores = 1
  )
  
  fit$sdy <- sdy
  fit$metabolite <- i
  
  flnm <- paste('./MLresults16s/metabolite_16smodels_nestedcv',
                i %>% 
                  gsub('-','',x = .) %>% 
                  gsub(' ','',x = .) %>% 
                  gsub(',','',x = .),
                '_v2.RData', sep = '')
  save(file = flnm, list = c('fit','i'))
}

```


#### From ITS to NMR

```{r, eval = F}
phyITSpp <- phyITS %>% 
  subset_samples(!is.na(Sample.ID)) %>% 
  subset_samples(!is.na(X2.hydroxyisovaleric.acid)) %>% 
  transform_sample_counts(function(x) as.numeric(x>0)) %>% 
  filter_taxa(function(x) sum(x > 0)>9, TRUE) 

X <- phyITSpp@otu_table %>% data.frame()
X <- log(X + +0.0001)
Y <- phyITSpp@sam_data %>% data.frame() %>% dplyr::select(-TSP,-ERECTIC)

folds <- make_loio_folds(Y$Participant)

unmet <- unique(MEconc_newlong$met) 
unmet <- unmet[!(unmet %in% c("ERECTIC","TSP"))] 
for (i in unmet){
  print(i)
  
  yy <- MEconc_newlong %>% filter(met==i) %>% filter(!is.na(Participant)) %>% filter(`Blood origen`=='ME') 
  YY <- Y %>% 
    left_join(yy, by = c('Participant','Period','Cycle.day' = 'Cycle day'))
  
  y <- YY$logy
  sdy <- sd(y)
  
  fit <- nestedcv::nestcv.train(
    x = X,
    y = y,
    method = "spls",                  # any caret model
    preProc = c("center", 'scale'),
    tuneGrid = expand.grid(K = 1:2,# K sets number of components
                           eta = seq(0,1,0.1), # eta sets sparsity
                           kappa = 0.5),
    outer_folds = folds$outer_folds,
    inner_folds = folds$inner_folds,
    finalCV = FALSE,
    cv.cores = 1
  )
  
  fit$sdy <- sdy
  fit$metabolite <- i
  
  flnm <- paste('./MLresultsITS/metabolite_ITSmodels_nestedcv',
                i %>% 
                  gsub('-','',x = .) %>% 
                  gsub(' ','',x = .) %>% 
                  gsub(',','',x = .),
                '_v2.RData', sep = '')
  save(file = flnm, list = c('fit','i'))
}

```


```{r, eval=FALSE}
library(caret)
library(nestedcv)

flnm <- list.files('./MLresults16s/')
beta <- res16s <- data.frame()
for (fl in flnm){
  load(file = paste('./MLresults16s/',fl,sep = ''))
  k <- summary(fit)$final_param$K
  
  s <- summary(fit)$result %>% as.data.frame() %>% 
    rownames_to_column('stat') %>% 
    mutate(metabolite = i,method = '16s',sdy = fit$sdy, ncomp = k)
  s$x <- as.numeric(s$x)
  res16s <- bind_rows(res16s,s)
  
  
  beta <- beta %>% bind_rows(data.frame(breg = fit$final_fit$finalModel$betahat,
                                        metabolite = i, 
                                        method = '16s',
                                        sdy = fit$sdy, 
                                        ncomp = k
                                        ) %>% 
                               rownames_to_column('OTU'))
}

flnm <- list.files('./MLresultsITS/')
resITS <- data.frame()
for (fl in flnm){
  load(file = paste('./MLresultsITS/',fl,sep = ''))
  k <- summary(fit)$final_param$K
  s <- summary(fit)$result %>% as.data.frame() %>% 
    rownames_to_column('stat') %>% 
    mutate(metabolite = i,method = 'ITS',sdy = fit$sdy, ncomp = k)
  s$x <- as.numeric(s$x)
  resITS <- bind_rows(resITS,s)
  
  beta <- beta %>% bind_rows(data.frame(breg = fit$final_fit$finalModel$betahat,
                                        metabolite = i, 
                                        method = 'ITS',
                                        sdy = fit$sdy, 
                                        ncomp = k
                                        ) %>% 
                               rownames_to_column('OTU'))
}

load(file = '~/OneDrive - University of Copenhagen/KU_work/menstrual_effluent/multiomics_menstrual_effluent/RMSE0_loio.RData')

MLstat16s <- RMSE0 %>% left_join(res16s %>% filter(stat=='RMSE') %>% filter(!duplicated(metabolite))) %>% mutate(method = '16s') 
MLstatITS <- RMSE0 %>% left_join(resITS %>% filter(stat=='RMSE') %>% filter(!duplicated(metabolite)))  %>% mutate(method = 'ITS') 

MLstat <- bind_rows(MLstat16s,MLstatITS) %>% 
  mutate(stat = 'RMSE', 
         ncomp = ifelse(is.na(x),0,ncomp),
         x = ifelse(is.na(x),rmse0,x)) %>% 
  left_join(MEclass, by = c('metabolite' = 'Interval_name2')) 

beta <- beta %>% left_join(MEclass, by = c('metabolite' = 'Interval_name2')) 
save(file = '~/OneDrive - University of Copenhagen/KU_work/menstrual_effluent/multiomics_menstrual_effluent/MLstats.RData', 
     list = c('MLstat','res16s','resITS', 'beta'))
```


### Per metabolite - CV predictive perormance.

```{r}
load(file = '~/OneDrive - University of Copenhagen/KU_work/menstrual_effluent/multiomics_menstrual_effluent/MLstats.RData')

MLstat <- MLstat %>% 
  mutate(
    Rsquared = 1 - (x^2 / rmse0^2),
    quality = ifelse(Rsquared < (-0.2),'overfitted','ok'),
    Rsquared = ifelse(Rsquared < (-0.2),-0.2,Rsquared)) 
MLstat %>%
  ggplot(data = ., aes(substr(metabolite,1,50),Rsquared, color = method, shape = quality)) + 
  geom_point() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))

```

Figure 5A in publication

```{r}
library(gplots)

ggbeta <- beta %>% 
  left_join(MLstat %>% dplyr::select(rmse0,x,Rsquared, metabolite,method,ncomp), by = c('metabolite','method')) %>% 
  left_join(dflb, by = 'category') %>%
  mutate(breg = breg/sdy) %>% 
  filter(method == '16s') %>% 
  filter(Rsquared>0.5) %>% 
  left_join(tb_lmer2 %>% dplyr::select(OTU,met,estimate:pvcut), by = c('OTU','metabolite' = 'met')) %>% 
  group_by(metabolite) %>% 
  mutate(nn = sum(abs(breg)>0)) %>% 
  filter(nn>0) %>% 
  group_by(OTU) %>% 
  mutate(nn2 = sum(abs(breg)>0)) %>% 
  filter(nn2>0) %>% 
  left_join(phyX@tax_table %>% data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column('OTU') %>% 
              left_join(bsum16s, by = c('ta2','ta3','ta4','ta5')), by = 'OTU') %>% 
  ungroup %>% 
  mutate(taxall = paste(ta2,ta3,ta4,ta5, sep = '') %>% factor() %>% as.numeric(),
    OTU = OTU %>% fct_reorder(taxall)) %>% 
  mutate(stars = gtools::stars.pval(qval)) 

lbs <- ggbeta %>% 
  group_by(OTU) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(lb = ta5[1], 
                   lb4 = ta4[1], 
                   lb3 = ta3[1], 
                   lb2 = ta2[1], 
                   n()) %>% 
  arrange(lb)

# 1) find lowest level of id, 2) remove F__
for (i in which(nchar(lbs$lb)<4)){
  id <- which(nchar(lbs[i,])>4)[1]
  if (is.na(id)) {
    lbs$lb[i] <- 'unassigned'
  }
  else {
  # print(as.character(lbs[i,id]))
  lbs$lb[i] <- as.character(lbs[i,id])
  }
}

lbs <- lbs %>% 
  mutate(lb = lb %>% 
           gsub('F__','',x = .) %>% 
           gsub('__','-',x = .))


g5_all <- ggbeta %>% 
  # remove bin from mtb label
  mutate(metabolite = gsub('bin.','',x = metabolite)) %>% 
  # filter of only bins / unk
  # filter(nchar(metabolite)>6) %>% 
  mutate(metabolite = gsub('X2.','2-',x = metabolite)) %>% 
  # filter(!str_detect(metabolite,'unk')) %>% 
  # filter(!str_detect(metabolite,'1_2')) %>% 
  ggplot(data = ., aes(metabolite,OTU,fill = breg,label = stars)) + 
  geom_tile() + 
  geom_text() + 
  scale_y_discrete(labels = lbs$lb,breaks =lbs$OTU ) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(mid = 'white',midpoint = 0) + 
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(legend.position = 'top', axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5)) + 
  xlab(NULL) + ylab(NULL)


g5_sel <- ggbeta %>% 
  # remove bin from mtb label
  mutate(metabolite = gsub('bin-','',x = metabolite)) %>% 
  mutate(metabolite = gsub('1_2','',x = metabolite) %>% trimws()) %>% 
  # filter of only bins / unk
  filter(nchar(metabolite)>6) %>%
  filter(!str_detect(metabolite,'unk')) %>%
  
  # filter(!str_detect(metabolite,'1_2')) %>%
  ggplot(data = ., aes(metabolite,OTU,fill = breg, label = stars)) + 
  geom_tile() + 
  scale_y_discrete(labels = lbs$lb,breaks =lbs$OTU ) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(mid = 'white',midpoint = 0) + 
  geom_text() + 
  # scale_color_manual(values = alpha(c('white','black'))) + #,c(0,1))) + 
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(legend.position = 'top', axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5)) + 
  xlab(NULL) + ylab(NULL)
```
